description: This is a tall, slender corner storage cabinet with a modern and minimalist design. It features a light, whitewashed wood-grain finish. The left side has a full-length door with a sleek, vertical black handle for concealed storage. The right side is designed to fit into a corner, offering multiple open, triangular shelves for display or easy access. The cabinet stands on a slightly recessed base, giving it a clean, floating appearance. Its vertical orientation and corner design make it ideal for maximizing storage in smaller spaces.
